title: Windows Hub cannot start the Codex cmd shim
original_report: Hobbyka Hub 0.4.26 downloads hobbyka-agent-chat on Windows but fails before registration with spawnSync codex.cmd EINVAL; selecting a protected executable directly produces EPERM.
discovery_scope: plugins/hobbyka-hub/bin/hobbyka-hub.mjs shared run and capture helpers
all Codex CLI call sites used by install, update, and marketplace registration
Node.js child_process documentation for Windows cmd files and DEP0190
expected: Hub invokes the installed Codex CLI, registers hobbyka-agent-chat@hobbyka-hub, and confirms installation.
actual: Node.js 24 rejects direct execution of codex.cmd with EINVAL, so installation exits before registration and confirmation.
environment: Reported on Windows with Hobbyka Hub 0.4.26 and Node.js 24; focused regression verified on macOS because no reachable Windows runner was available.
reproduction: A focused test requires .cmd shims to be routed through cmd.exe without shell:true, verifies quoting, rejects cmd metacharacters, and keeps marketplace paths out of the command string.
failure_signal: The focused test exits 1 because the shared process helper directly passes codex.cmd to spawnSync and has no safe Windows command path.
root_cause: Windows .cmd files are shell scripts rather than directly executable programs. Hub passed codex.cmd to spawnSync without cmd.exe, which Node.js documents as unsupported on Windows.
fix_summary: Route only Windows .cmd and .bat executables through cmd.exe /d /s /c with explicit quoting, metacharacter rejection, hidden execution, and verbatim arguments; keep all native executables on direct spawnSync.
why_causal: The corrected shared helper handles every Codex CLI call and removes the direct .cmd execution that produced EINVAL without enabling Node's unsafe shell:true argument concatenation.

reproduction_files.summary: Focused Windows cmd invocation and injection regression test.

fix_files.summary: Safe .cmd/.bat execution in the shared process helper.

checks.name: Focused regression
checks.detail: The same command changed from exit 1 to exit 0.

limitations: No reachable Windows runner was available; Valera must repeat the original install command with the released Hub version.
residual_risks: A custom HOBBYKA_CODEX_COMMAND containing cmd metacharacters is rejected instead of executed.
notes: No dependency was added and shell:true is intentionally not used because Node.js DEP0190 warns that its args array is not escaped.
